overview: The YouTube Idea Generator Crew is a Python-based project designed to generate ideas for YouTube videos. The project consists of several components, including a crew module, a main module, and various tools.

docs.title: Comprehensive Overview
docs.description: This document provides a high-level overview of the YouTube Idea Generator Crew project, including its purpose, components, and functionality.
docs.goal: To understand the project's overall architecture and purpose.

docs.title: System Architecture and Key Design Decisions
docs.description: This document delves into the project's system architecture, including the modular design, object-oriented programming principles, and dependency injection. It also discusses key design decisions and their rationale.
docs.prerequisites: Basic understanding of software architecture and design patterns
docs.goal: To understand the project's technical design and architecture.

docs.title: Core Workflows and Data Flows
docs.description: This document explains the core workflows and data flows within the project, including the crew module's idea generation process, the main module's entry point, and the tools module's custom tools.
docs.prerequisites: Understanding of the project's components and functionality
docs.goal: To understand how the project's components interact and process data.

docs.title: High-Level Component Interactions
docs.description: This document provides a high-level overview of how the project's components interact with each other, including the main module's interaction with the crew module and the tools module.
docs.prerequisites: Understanding of the project's components and functionality
examples: Main module and crew module interaction example
docs.goal: To understand how the project's components work together to achieve the overall goal.

docs.title: Getting Started Guide
docs.description: This document provides a step-by-step guide on how to get started with the YouTube Idea Generator Crew project, including installation, setup, and basic usage.
docs.goal: To enable users to quickly get started with the project and begin generating ideas for YouTube videos.
